exact_claim: For every n>=3, the determinant Gram locus G_n of the closed real binary-tensor Frobenius unit ball cannot equal {d in C_n:P(d)>=0} for any real determinant-only polynomial P. The same nonexistence holds with ambient H_n. This settles the original single-polynomial question negatively for n>=4 and also establishes n=3.
